name: Is it better to hire a general contractor or separate handymen for rental repairs?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hire a general contractor or separate handymen for rental repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with an independent general contractor gives you a single point of contact who handles diverse interior trades directly rather than juggling separate painters, drywallers, and tile installers. An owner-operated contractor manages carpentry, tile, drywall, and painting in-house while coordinating licensed electrical and plumbing sub-trades as needed. The practical tradeoff is that a dedicated contractor may require scheduled advance booking compared to an in-house property management maintenance crew, but you get higher-quality finish work and accountability for complex repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor provides single-point management across drywall, tile, paint, and sub-trades, ensuring consistent craftsmanship on multi-task repairs.
